about_the_game:
Urgh, Urgha and Claw the Cave Bear must survive the harsh prehistoric winter - help them gather resources and craft their way to cozy and warm spring!

Don't Freeze is a simple, bite-sized worker placement board game in which you must gather materials, convert them to usable resources and make sure that the entire family (including the bear) survives a set number of turns. You must hunt to provide food, collect wood to kindle the fire and gather herbs to turn into medicine in case someone gets sick.

  • Simple rules and small numbers allow you to quickly grasp the game and don't stand in the way of interesting strategic and tactical choices

  • One game lasts only a few minutes - perfect for a coffee break

  • Several difficulty levels will infect you with the "just one more game" syndrome

  • Adorable programmer art instead of AI nonsense

  • Developed solo in the middle of a harsh Polish winter. Well, maybe not that harsh, but still winter. There were negative temperatures in the middle of April for crying out loud!
